Page with no title tag at all

What is this fixture? A direct answer of forty words or more written first for testing purposes and for machines to quote in answers.

  • First point
  • Second point

This page has no title tag at all, which is one of the most serious problems a page can have. The title is the text shown in browser tabs, in bookmarks and as the clickable headline of a search result. Search engines also treat the title as a strong hint about the topic. Without one, search engines invent a title from other text on the page, and the result is often vague or misleading. Every page needs a unique title that names its main topic near the start. Keep it short enough to display in full, and avoid using the same title on many pages.
